data.name: Fearia Clicker
data.detailed_description:
Fearia Clicker is a unique take on the horror genre.

You are tasked with destroying an ancient artifact that is being used to power an army of monsters and entities, all while fending them off.

Fearia Clicker at it's core, is a clicker game, but I wanted it to be so much more, so I took everything I loved about my favourite game genres and put them right here.

Clickers, Roguelikes, Soulslikes, Psychological Horrors, and blended them all just right...

don't let the phrase "Soulslike" scare you, Fearia Clicker's unique combat and build system allows players to choose their own way to play!

Wanna challenge yourself?

Awesome, Use what you know and master each bosses' unique - manually scripted attack patterns and take them down with precision and skill!

Wanna grind instead?

Great! The build system allows you to infinitely and exponentially upgrade your strength. From generic power upgrades, all the way to insanely rare and unique trinkets that totally destroys a bosses' day.

These systems allow you to progress at your own pace, play YOUR way, in YOUR style, and have fun doing it no matter what you choose to do.

Like grinding RARE and EXCLUSIVE things? Me too!

There are a ton of different monsters to encounter, each in different rarity categories, and each with their own even RARER SHINY varient that unlocks a special page in the logbook when defeated. Real players will go for 100% logbooks ;)

Fearia Clicker contains secrets, puzzles, challenges, multiple chapters, (dlc chapters in the future), and a crazy variety of monsters and entities to encounter in your journey.

Uncover the story with environmental storytelling, logbooks obtained by defeating monsters and bosses, theres always more to discover.

( please read this bit :) )

And on the Developer side, I made this game on my own, fuelled only by my passion of games.

You won't find microtransactions, overpriced dlc's, unfair gameplay, time wasting gameplay. None of that garbage we don't want in a game.

So please, if YOU have any suggestions for my game, join us in the discord, I'll listen.
